scripts.db:backup: powershell -Command "if (!(Test-Path backups)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory backups } ; $ts = Get-Date -Format yyyyMMdd_HHmmss ; docker exec rentflow-postgres pg_dump -U rentflow -F c -f /tmp/rentflow_$ts.backup rentflow ; docker cp rentflow-postgres:/tmp/rentflow_$ts.backup ./backups/rentflow_$ts.backup"
scripts.db:restore: powershell -Command "docker cp ./backups/rentflow.backup rentflow-postgres:/tmp/rentflow.backup ; docker exec rentflow-postgres pg_restore -U rentflow -d rentflow --clean --if-exists /tmp/rentflow.backup"
scripts.minio:backup: powershell -Command "if (!(Test-Path backups)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory backups } ; $ts = Get-Date -Format yyyyMMdd_HHmmss ; Compress-Archive -Path minio-data\* -DestinationPath backups\minio_$ts.zip"
scripts.minio:restore: powershell -Command "docker compose down ; if (Test-Path minio-data) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force minio-data } ; Expand-Archive backups\minio.zip -DestinationPath minio-data ; docker compose up -d"
scripts.backup:all: npm run db:backup && npm run minio:backup
scripts.restore:all: npm run minio:restore && npm run db:restore
